name: composer
description: Python service. This package.json exists only so the composer joins the pnpm workspace and is covered by the single `pnpm lint` / `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm test` entrypoints. All real work is delegated to uv.

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src tests && uv run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix src tests && uv run ruff format src tests
